description_en: Activates a specified pay-as-you-go sub-service of Application Real-Time Monitoring Service (ARMS)
description_zh: 开通ARMS下指定子产品的后付费功能
kebab_example: aliyun arms open-arms-service-second-version --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --type arms --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: OpenArmsServiceSecondVersion

parameters.help_en:
The type of the service. Valid values:

`arms`: ARMS
`arms_app`: Application Monitoring
`arms_web`: Browser Monitoring
`prometheus_monitor`: Managed Service for Prometheus
`synthetic_post`: Synthetic Monitoring
parameters.help_zh:
服务类型：

`arms`：ARMS
`arms_app`：应用监控
`arms_web`：前端监控
`prometheus_monitor`：Prometheus监控
`synthetic_post`：云拨测
parameters.name: type

OrderId.description_en: The service ID returned if the service is activated
OrderId.description_zh: 开通成功后返回的服务ID
